cues.en: A forest in Horizon Zero Dawn
takes more than simply adding trees.
Paths need to remain clear,
while suitable plants fill each region.
The developers turn artist-defined data and rules

cues.ko: 그래픽 처리 장치인 지피유에서 배치로 바꾸었습니다.
cues.en: into placements on the GPU, the graphics processor.
The starting point is a map.
It stores where trees should be dense

cues.ko: 물과 길은 어디인지 같은 정보를 저장합니다.
cues.en: and where water and paths are located.
Plant types and appearance are set by region.
Artists adjust the maps and plant assets.

cues.ko: 자동 배치에도 사람이 정하는 방향이 있습니다.
cues.en: Automated placement still has human direction.
Next, build a density map.
It determines how much vegetation to place.
Exclude areas occupied by roads and water.

cues.ko: 여러 조건을 연결해 배치용 지도를 완성합니다.
cues.en: Combine the conditions into a map for placement.
Now compare candidate points with the map.
Check the density condition at each candidate
and retain the points that pass.
Spacing and point patterns are also controlled.

cues.ko: 아무 곳에나 나무를 쌓는 방식과는 다릅니다.
cues.en: This differs from piling trees at arbitrary positions.
Actual objects are placed at the remaining points.
Align them with the terrain’s height and orientation,

cues.ko: 크기나 방향의 변화를 더할 수 있습니다.
cues.en: and add variation in scale or rotation.
A point in the map becomes

cues.ko: 화면 속 풀이나 나무로 바뀌는 단계입니다.
cues.en: a tuft of grass or a tree on screen.

cues.ko: 층이 늘면 서로 겹치는 문제도 생깁니다.
cues.en: More placement layers can introduce overlaps.
The presentation explains how multiple layers

cues.ko: 밀도 범위를 나눠 쓰도록 조정하는 방법을 설명합니다.
cues.en: can be coordinated by sharing density ranges.

cues.ko: 풀, 돌, 나무를 각각 채우기만 하면 끝나는 일이 아닌 거죠.
cues.en: Filling grass, rocks and trees separately is not enough.
In order: artist maps, placement conditions,
candidate tests, then actual objects.
With the computer handling repetitive placement,
artists can refine the forest’s character
and the flow of its paths more quickly.
